channel.title: The Latin Wire
channel.description: Politics, business, entertainment, sports and culture for Hispanics

item.title: Kany García brings 'Puerta Abierta' tour to the United States
item.description: The seven-time Latin Grammy winner brings her biggest tour yet stateside, opening September 7 in California and wrapping October 4 in Orlando.

item.title: Infantino confirms re-election bid despite World Cup sell-off backlash
item.description: Infantino will seek a fourth FIFA term in March 2027 despite a failed $20 billion tournament sell-off that cost him the support of three major confederations.

item.title: Witkoff and Kushner visit Kyiv for first time in peace push
item.description: The Witkoff-Kushner shuttle between Moscow and Kyiv revives a diplomatic architecture not seen since the war's earliest days.

item.title: El-Sayed's past remarks and associations draw scrutiny in Michigan Senate race
item.description: Democratic nominee Abdul El-Sayed faces questions over DSA appearances, past remarks on upward mobility, and his association with controversial public figures.

item.title: Former Air Force secretary and new poll raise doubts over Iran war
item.description: A former Air Force secretary questioned the advice Trump received before entering the conflict, as a new poll shows softening Republican support.

item.title: ICE issues court notices to migrants not fully processed amid CBP Home probe
item.description: ICE is filing court notices for roughly 445,000 migrants released without full processing, as the administration's CBP Home app pushes voluntary departures.

item.title: Argentina marks 1,000 days of Milei with mixed economic results
item.description: Inflation crashed, poverty fell, and country risk dropped sharply—but unemployment climbed and formal jobs shrank over Milei's first 1,000 days.

item.title: Missouri asks U.S. Supreme Court to restore blocked redistricting map
item.description: Missouri's redistricting clash at the Supreme Court echoes a long national argument about who ultimately draws the lines of political power.

item.title: Mexico eyes Arizona semiconductor role as USMCA review stalls
item.description: Ebrard signs ASU deal and meets chip giants in Phoenix as USMCA talks drag past deadline with no automotive deal in sight.

item.title: USMCA talks collapse raises stakes for US-Mexico trade
item.description: US-Canada USMCA talks collapsed in August 2026, triggering 50% tariffs and raising pressure on Mexico negotiations that could reshape North American trade.

item.title: Inter Miami draws 2-2 with Atlanta after weather delay, Hoyos blasts referees
item.description: A 95-minute weather delay and a late Atlanta penalty denied Inter Miami a home win, sending interim coach Guillermo Hoyos into a post-match tirade against officials.

item.title: Inter Miami draw 2-2 with Atlanta United in weather-delayed match
item.description: A late Breel Embolo penalty denied Inter Miami all three points Saturday, leaving the Herons at 12-6-5 on the season.

item.title: AfD votes in Saxony-Anhalt election seeking first far-right state government
item.description: Voters in Saxony-Anhalt cast ballots Sunday in a race that could produce Germany's first far-right state government since World War II.

item.title: Suárez scores in Inter Miami's 2-2 draw with Atlanta United
item.description: Luis Suárez netted his 12th goal but a late Breel Embolo penalty denied Inter Miami all three points at Nu Stadium.

item.title: Democrats lead fundraising in state and U.S. House races ahead of November
item.description: Democratic candidates hold cash advantages in most competitive Michigan races, while national Democrats expand their House target map into traditionally Republican territory.

item.title: Almirón penalty miss helps Inter Miami hold Atlanta to 2-2 draw
item.description: St. Clair stopped Almirón's spot kick, but Embolo's late conversion rescued Atlanta in a stormy Miami night.

item.title: Putin orders 72-hour Kyiv ceasefire as US envoys visit Moscow
item.description: Putin announced a 72-hour halt to strikes on Kyiv as U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner prepared visits to both Moscow and the Ukrainian capital.

item.title: Messi assists both goals as Inter Miami draw 2-2 with Atlanta
item.description: Lionel Messi set up both goals but a late Breel Embolo penalty denied Inter Miami a win in a storm-delayed thriller.

item.title: Guyana receives six Cuban and Afghan deportees under US third-country program
item.description: Guyana's one-year agreement to host six Cuban and Afghan deportees offers a window into how third-country removal programs are quietly reshaping migration diplomacy.

item.title: Orlando City B beats Inter Miami CF II 4-1 in MLS Next Pro road win
item.description: Orlando City B scored three first-half goals and cruised to a 4-1 road victory over last-place Inter Miami CF II on Friday.

item.title: Pentagon polygraphed ~50 Joint Staff members over Iran war munitions leaks
item.description: About 50 Joint Staff officers and civilian employees were polygraphed in August 2026 over leaks about U.S. munitions shortfalls in the Iran war.

item.title: Casemiro header opens scoring as Inter Miami draw 2-2 with Atlanta
item.description: Casemiro scored and conceded twice as Inter Miami dropped two points in a 2-2 Saturday night draw with Atlanta United.

item.title: Weather delay pushes back Inter Miami vs. Atlanta United kickoff
item.description: A lightning-triggered safety protocol pushed the Eastern Conference clash back 95 minutes, with second-place Inter Miami riding a 7-1 wave.

item.title: Argentina market survey cuts 2026 growth forecast, sees stable inflation
item.description: Forty-seven analysts slashed Argentina's 2026 GDP forecast to 2.1%, less than half the government's budget target, while projecting stable monthly inflation through early 2027.

item.title: Judge extends block on USPS mail ballot rules ahead of midterms
item.description: A federal judge's indefinite block on USPS mail-ballot rules sets up a Supreme Court showdown with November approaching fast.

item.title: Argentina faces host Poland as 2026 U-20 Women's World Cup opens
item.description: The 2026 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup kicked off September 5 in Poland, with host Poland taking on Argentina in Katowice.

item.title: Hybrid and electric car sales in Argentina surge 177% year-on-year in August
item.description: Argentina registered 7,656 electrified vehicles in August 2026, a 177% year-on-year jump driven by a zero-tariff decree on imported models.

item.title: Trump administration uses FEMA space for hearings, tells judges to cut case delays
item.description: The administration is converting FEMA conference space for immigration hearings and directing judges to limit delays, according to reporting by The Washington Post and the Guardian.

item.title: MAGA Inc. spends $10 million on Texas Senate ads for Paxton
item.description: A $10 million super-PAC commitment in Texas reveals how structural money gaps and Trump's midterm ambitions are converging in a single Senate race.

item.title: USMCA review pressures Mexico on labor, trade and dairy
item.description: The USMCA's first formal review is reshaping labor rules, dairy trade, and diplomatic strategy across North America.

item.title: Mexico ranks fourth globally in tourism economic contribution
item.description: Mexico's travel and tourism sector added $149.4 billion directly to GDP in 2025, landing the country fourth worldwide behind the U.S., China, and Germany.

item.title: Gallup shows Democratic party-ID lead as Hispanic voter warnings mount
item.description: A Gallup survey shows Democrats opening a six-point party-ID lead, even as strategists warn the socialism label threatens the party's standing with Hispanic voters.

item.title: Supreme Court restores discounted TV ad rates for party committees
item.description: A Supreme Court emergency order over TV ad discount rates opens a window onto how broadcast law, campaign finance, and electoral competition quietly intertwine.

item.title: Kennedy Center ceiling collapses, board renews call to close for renovations
item.description: A section of ceiling fell in the Grand Foyer during a Friday rainstorm, prompting renewed calls from the Kennedy Center board to close for renovations.

item.title: Fired border enforcer Bovino says Trump team not tough enough on deportations
item.description: Former Border Patrol commander-at-large Greg Bovino says the Trump administration fell short of its mass deportation promises and forced him out before he could finish the job.

item.title: US sanctions Cuba entities and Castro grandson, embassy issues health alert
item.description: The Trump administration sanctioned five Cuban entities and a Castro grandson on September 3, one day before the U.S. Embassy in Havana issued a health alert.

item.title: Trump threatens trade halt unless Fed cuts interest rates
item.description: President Trump threatened on Truth Social to halt trade with deficit nations unless the Federal Reserve cuts interest rates from their current 3.5% to 3.75% range.

item.title: Epyca warns global financial tightening threatens Argentina's debt and exports
item.description: Argentine consultancy Epyca says the collapse of a decades-old global financing arrangement puts Argentina's $40 billion debt pile and commodity exports at direct risk.

item.title: Cruz Azul vs Santos Laguna kickoff moved; Erik Lira stays at club
item.description: Liga MX moved the Cruz Azul–Santos kickoff three hours earlier to clear the airwaves for the Leagues Cup final in Houston.

item.title: Messi set to start as Inter Miami host Atlanta United
item.description: Messi starts Saturday after a four-goal, one-assist performance against Montréal as second-place Inter Miami host 27th-place Atlanta United.
